open_obligations.what_is_open: It remains open whether one data-measurable band can attain \(\sup_{P\in\mathcal P_n(\Lambda_n),\,x\in\mathcal B}\mathbb E_P[W_n(x)]/r_{n,P}^{\mathrm{loc}}(x)=O(1)\) on every declared triangular union, whether the matching local-ratio converse holds for unions without a nonempty pervasive component, and whether exact adaptation can be characterized only by score-law total variation.
open_obligations.obstruction: The proved conditional calibration controls all disk patterns through \(M_n\), so it incurs \(\log M_n\asymp\log n\) even when \(K_P(x,h)\) is bounded.  The frozen assumptions provide no observable, uniformly valid replacement by the local packing multiplicity.  Conversely, the disjoint-tent decoder supplies the requested local-ratio lower bound only when pervasive packing gives a growing codebook.  Finally, the general transfer inequality necessarily contains \(\operatorname{TV}(P_0^{\otimes n},P_1^{\otimes n})\) for the full observed laws; the model places no condition that makes this distance equivalent to \(\operatorname{TV}(P_X^{\otimes n},(P'_X)^{\otimes n})\).
open_obligations.attempted: Conditioning on the scores and union-bounding the finite disk-pattern class yields an explicit globally calibrated band; count-adaptive bandwidth selection yields its polynomial global rate.  Multiway disjoint Lipschitz tents yield both the global and pointwise local-benchmark converses on every nonempty pervasive component.  A two-law coverage-transfer argument yields a pointwise obstruction for arbitrary classes, but it is expressed in full observed-law total variation.  None of these arguments supplies local-multiplicity calibration or removes outcome-law distinguishability from the criterion.
